preamble: Fortition of the voiced dorsal fricative ghayn ([ɣ ~ ʁ]) to the voiceless uvular stop [q] is documented in Ḥassāniyya Arabic, where etymological ghayn is realized as [qː] when geminated and alternates freely with /q/ elsewhere, so that the two phonemes have merged for many speakers.

examples.note: Etymological ghayn is voiceless and plosive in geminated position.
In other positions etymological ghayn is in free variation with /q/.
